title: R2 · ribs over the steps and head
changes: Grooves now start at the head corner and carry on over the step faces. A groove is skipped only at a corner sharper than 80°, and where two would converge into a loose sliver in a concave corner. 98 grooves in all.
Grooves are 0.5 mm deep (r1: 0.6). The least wall to a hole is 0.6 mm (r1: 0.4).
The point is rounded to 0.5 mm in plan again (r1: 0.35), but stays a skinny needle, as Jake asked.
review: Possible pinholes at the head end of the jaw face (a grid of dots in jaw.png). A close-up render showed clean grooves: the dots were render speckle. genus.py counts exactly 33 holes, and the mesh is one watertight body.
Two plain bands are left at the step corners, where grooves were skipped. Raise the skip angle to about 100°.
The tip's skinniness matches, but its last 2-3 mm are under 0.8 mm wide in plan, which prints as a single line. Keep 0.8-1.0 mm out to about 1 mm from the point.
The edge-on taper may be a one-sided chisel in side.png. Low confidence. (Not taken.)
Grooves stop about 3 mm before the point, but the photo shows ribs reaching the nub. Run them to within about 1 mm.
